summary: Implemented a deterministic human-time ledger over existing durable events. Explicit HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED boundaries are the only source of human-boundary wait; HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED advances the human clock, worker signals do not; boundary_cleared can end a machine dependency without pretending the human acted; external conversations without durable endpoints remain EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED with null duration. The result exposes stable scale_readiness.human_bottleneck, human_touch_budget and Primary Chat projection fields without creating a new authority or scheduler.

feature_evidence.gate: define durable human event contract using existing owners
feature_evidence.evidence: HUMAN_TIME_LEDGER_V1.json defines HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED, HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED, boundary_cleared, EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED and WORKER_SIGNAL as projection inputs without granting authority.

feature_evidence.gate: human silence never bottleneck by itself
feature_evidence.evidence: silence fixture has two hours of human idle plus a recent worker signal and still yields human_decision_required=false, human_boundary_wait_ms=0 and human_silence_is_bottleneck=false.

feature_evidence.gate: derive round trips, avoidable handoffs, unavoidable gates and wait
feature_evidence.evidence: closed fixture deterministically yields round_trips=1, unavoidable=1, avoidable=1, boundary_wait=300000ms and action_wait=180000ms.

feature_evidence.gate: worker signals do not reset human clock
feature_evidence.evidence: open fixture records worker signals after the human action while human_idle_ms remains 600000ms at as_of.
external fixture records count=1 and external_unobserved_duration_ms=null.

feature_evidence.gate: Primary Chat/widget consumable fields without model
feature_evidence.evidence: deriveHumanTimeLedger returns deterministic primary_chat, human_touch_budget and scale_readiness.human_bottleneck objects.
